headline: Vedant Fashions to host virtual investor meet on Sep 17
summary: Vedant Fashions Limited has scheduled a one-to-one virtual meeting with investors and analysts for September 17, 2026. The company confirmed that discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: HGM board meets Sep 17 for strategic investments
summary: Handson Global Management (HGM) Ltd schedules board meeting on September 17, 2026, to consider strategic investment opportunities under SEBI LODR Regulation 30.

headline: Ola Electric to host analyst meeting on Sep 17
summary: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd will host a one-to-one meeting with Emkay Global Financial Services Ltd on September 17, 2026, at its Future Factory and Giga Factory in Bengaluru.

headline: ACME Solar commissions 53.63 MW BESS in Rajasthan
summary: ACME Solar Holdings commissions Phase-I of its 53.63 MW BESS project in Rajasthan. The facility, part of a larger FDRE project, achieves commercial operation on September 16, 2026.

headline: Stocks in Focus: Solar, Blackbuck, Raghav
summary: Solar Industries signs massive ₹12,951 crore Omnia deal. Blackbuck surges 7% post stake sale. Raghav Productivity posts strong growth. Check full briefing.

headline: Piramal Pharma's Morpeth facility gets 7 FDA observations
summary: Piramal Pharma's Morpeth facility received seven observations following a US FDA inspection, signalling regulatory scrutiny at the manufacturing site.

headline: Jubilant Foodworks EVP Virender Singh Sehrawat resigns
summary: Jubilant Foodworks Ltd announced the resignation of EVP & Head of Integrated Supply Chain Virender Singh Sehrawat. He cited an external opportunity and will leave on November 13, 2026.

headline: HeidelbergCement India signs 50-year limestone deal in MP
summary: HeidelbergCement India has signed a 50-year agreement for 63 million tonne of limestone reserves in Madhya Pradesh, securing long-term raw material supply for its cement operations.

headline: India to ease BA/BE study rules for drug approvals
summary: The government aims to simplify the regulatory process for bioavailability and bioequivalence studies in domestic drug approvals, signalling a push to streamline pharmaceutical regulations in India.

headline: Coforge retains FY27 guidance, targets >100% FCF
summary: Coforge maintains FY27 EBIT margin >15.5% and FCF/PAT >100%. Nomura rates Buy with ₹1,860 target as board governance strengthens.

headline: Blue Cloud Softech joins IndiaAI Centre in Odisha
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions confirmed as Industry Partner for IndiaAI Centre of Excellence in Bhubaneswar. The firm commits ₹4 crore and will provide mentorship to AI startups under MeitY approval.

headline: Flipkart may cap restaurant fees at 15-20%
summary: Flipkart is reportedly planning to cap restaurant commissions and ad spending at 15-20%, a move that could intensify competition in India's food delivery market against Swiggy and Eternal.

headline: Aditya Birla Housing Finance targets 15% ROE
summary: Aditya Birla Housing Finance aims for a 15% ROE and plans to nearly double its informal-income portfolio to 11% over the next 8-10 quarters, per a newspaper report.

headline: EU Commission confirms no probe into visa firms including VFS
summary: The EU Commission confirmed it has no investigation into visa-related issues for companies including VFS, a development relevant to BLS International Services.

headline: Cochin Shipyard confident on margin guidance
summary: Cochin Shipyard management states it will surpass margin guidance, citing a history of outperforming market targets over the past four to five years.

headline: JLR in talks with NATO countries on Defender
summary: Jaguar Land Rover is in talks with NATO member countries regarding its Defender model. The development involves Tata Motors' passenger vehicle subsidiary.

headline: Hexaware joins Project NANDA AI fellowship
summary: Hexaware Technologies collaborates on Project NANDA Fellowship to build open-source AI agent infrastructure. The three-month remote program involves 10+ fellows.

headline: Pearl Global Industries to allot 1:1 bonus shares
summary: Pearl Global Industries Limited has allotted 4.6 crore bonus shares in a 1:1 ratio. The record date is set for September 11, 2026, doubling the paid-up equity capital.

headline: Symphony Ltd to interact with NDTV Profit
summary: Symphony Limited's CMD Achal Bakeri will interact with NDTV Profit on September 15, 2026, to discuss the business overview. The telecast details are available on the company website.

headline: Afcom Holdings Co-MD highlights HPCL partnership
summary: Afcom Holdings' Co-MD has highlighted a long-term collaboration with HPCL covering steady fuel supply, quality assurance, and operational assistance to support the company's expanding cargo network.

headline: Pranav Constructions lists at 33% premium on NSE
summary: Pranav Constructions Limited made a strong stock market debut, listing at ₹165 per share on the NSE against an issue price of ₹124, a premium of ₹41 per share.

headline: Kellton Tech wins loan integration platform project
summary: Kellton Tech Solutions has been selected to develop a loan integration platform for a major automotive finance firm, highlighting its capabilities in lending technology and AI modernisation.

headline: Maharashtra Scooters declares ₹160 interim dividend
summary: Maharashtra Scooters has announced an interim dividend of ₹160 per share. The record date for eligibility has been set as September 21, 2026.

headline: Bajaj Holdings declares ₹65 interim dividend
summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment declares an interim dividend of ₹65 per share for FY27. The record date is set for September 21, 2026, with payout by October 13.

headline: SRG Housing Finance to host investor meet on Sep 16
summary: SRG Housing Finance Limited will host a virtual analyst meet on September 16, 2026, to address media rumors. The session aims to provide clarity on recent newspaper reports concerning the company.

headline: Stovec Industries promoter shares encumbered
summary: Print Holdings B.V. disclosed encumbrance on Stovec Industries promoter shares via a shareholders agreement. The arrangement involves debt restructuring and transfer restrictions for 71.06% holding.

headline: Neuland starts first peptide module
summary: Neuland Laboratories begins operations of its first commercial peptide manufacturing module with 7,000L capacity. The firm plans further expansion to meet rising demand in oncology and obesity treatments.

headline: Neuland Labs Co-MD focuses on pharma partnerships
summary: Neuland Laboratories' Co-MD aims to strengthen partnerships with top pharma and biotech firms to meet customer needs over the next decade.

headline: DIACABS wins ₹179.43 cr MV cable order from Adani Electricity
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure secures a ₹179.43 crore order from Adani Electricity Mumbai Limited for supply of approximately 871 kms of MV and LV underground power cables for Mumbai's network.

headline: izmo Microsystems unveils silicon photonics modules at SEMICON India 2026
summary: izmo Microsystems showcases production-ready silicon photonics packaging and quantum modules at SEMICON India 2026. The firm highlights its role as the first Indian company with such advanced packaging capabilities for AI and quantum infrastructure.

headline: Shah Metacorp promoter acquires 2.75 crore shares via warrants
summary: Mona Viral Shah acquires 2,75,00,000 equity shares of Shah Metacorp through warrant conversion, raising stake to 17.23%. Promoter group holds 32.08% post-acquisition.

headline: SJ Corp promoter Kalpesh Patel acquires 0.71% stake
summary: Promoter Kalpesh Patel acquired 3,08,140 shares in SJ Corporation Ltd, raising his stake to 3.29%. The off-market transaction followed a Share Purchase Agreement and open offer closure.

headline: Umang Savani buys 2.98% stake in SJ Corp
summary: Promoter Umang Kantilal Savani acquired 12,93,578 shares in SJ Corporation Ltd via off-market deal. His stake rises to 13.82% following the completion of an open offer.

headline: Sangam seeks shareholder nod for Ranjan Jagetia as independent director
summary: Sangam (India) Limited has initiated a postal ballot to appoint Mr. Ranjan Jagetia as an independent director for three years. The e-voting window opens on September 16, 2026, and closes on October 15, 2026.

headline: STC fined ₹1.53 lakh each by BSE, NSE for delayed results
summary: State Trading Corporation of India Ltd received penalties from both exchanges for failing to submit Q1FY27 financial results within the prescribed timeframe under SEBI regulations.

headline: Avonmore Capital promoter buys 130,481 shares
summary: Innovative Money Matters Private Limited, a promoter of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Ltd, acquired 130,481 shares in the open market on September 11, 2026. The stake increased to 33.71%.

headline: Signet Industries promoter Mukesh Sangla buys 5989 shares
summary: Promoter Mukesh Sangla acquired 5989 equity shares of Signet Industries Limited in the open market on September 11, 2026. His total holding rose to 1,418,559 shares, representing 4.82% of the voting capital.

headline: Vipul Organics CMD Wins Hall of Fame Award
summary: Vipul P. Shah, CMD of Vipul Organics Limited, received the Hall of Fame Award from Manufacturing Today at its 2026 conference in Mumbai. The recognition highlights his leadership in the specialty chemicals sector.

headline: Blue Star flags weak margins in second quarter
summary: Blue Star expects weak margins in the second quarter, according to an interview. The company flagged margin pressure as a key concern for the period.

headline: TechEra Engineering wins ₹7.51 crore aerospace orders
summary: TechEra Engineering secured ₹7.51 crore orders from an Indian PSU aerospace and defence firm for structural assembly packages of rear fuselage and LCA MK1A air intake.

headline: Jd Cables wins Rs 12 crore order from Private Entity for cables
summary: Jd Cables secures a confirmed Rs 12 crore work order for cable supply. This adds to the Q2FY27 inflow of Rs 18 crore. With zero TTM revenue, backlog visibility is high, but execution capacity and working capital funding remain key metrics to watch.

headline: Rohit Gupta HUF acquires 5000 CSL Finance shares
summary: Promoter group entity Rohit Gupta HUF acquired 5000 equity shares of CSL Finance Limited on September 9, 2026. The open market purchase raises its total holding to 449686 shares, representing 1.97% of the company's voting capital.

headline: GNA Axles promoter Surinder Kaur acquires 1.16% stake
summary: Promoter group member Surinder Kaur acquired 500,000 equity shares of GNA Axles Limited via inter-se transfer. The acquisition increases her holding to 1.16% of the total voting capital.

headline: Schaeffler India showcases motion tech at bauma CONEXPO
summary: Schaeffler India displays next-gen motion technology solutions for construction equipment at bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2026, highlighting electrification and efficiency.

headline: Navigant Corporate Advisors promoter sells 80,000 shares
summary: Promoter Sarthak Vijlani and PAC sold 80,000 shares (2.54%) of Navigant Corporate Advisors Ltd in open market on Sept 11, 2026. Holding drops to 25.38%.

headline: Jyothy Labs to host Nalanda Capital meet
summary: Jyothy Labs Limited has scheduled a one-on-one investor meeting with Nalanda Capital for September 23, 2026, as per SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Jyothy Labs to host investor meet on Sep 18
summary: Jyothy Labs Limited will hold a one-on-one investor meeting with KC Capital on September 18, 2026. The company confirmed no UPSI will be shared during the session.

headline: Jyothy Labs to host investor meet on Sep 25
summary: Jyothy Labs Limited will hold a one-on-one meeting with Pari Washington Company Advisors Pvt Ltd on September 25, 2026, under SEBI LODR regulations.
